remarks: Experience gracious colonial living with an inviting open floor plan that perfectly suits today's lifestyle. Nestled on a park-like acre at the end of a prime Upper Newfield cul-de-sac, this residence offers proximity to schools, Sterling Farms golf, tennis, theater, and is just minutes away from shops and the Merritt Parkway.  Step into the handsome living room featuring a cozy fireplace, seamlessly flowing into the formal dining room. French doors lead you to the heart of the home-the dynamic cathedral ceiling sunroom, casual dining area, and expansive eat-in kitchen. This grand space boasts captivating windows and French doors that flood the interior with natural light, extending the living space outdoors to the deck and yard.  The spacious chef's kitchen is a delight with a center island topped with new granite countertops and upscale stainless steel appliances. A family room with another fireplace and sliders to the deck provides the perfect spot for relaxation. Additionally, the main floor offers a versatile fifth bedroom or office along with a full bath, ideal for accommodating guests.  Enjoy fabulous updates including a new marble master bathroom, a roof replacement in 2012, central air installation in 2008, kitchen updates, and a lower level playroom-detailed in the feature sheet. This home is truly a wow!
